Summary: Validates the response from a user read operation, ensuring the request was successful and data is returned.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    void: Ensures the response has a status code of 200 and non-empty JSON data, raising an assertion error if invalid.

Description: This function is used to validate the response from a user read operation. It checks that the HTTP status code is 200 (indicating success) and that the response contains at least one user record. This is useful for ensuring that the API endpoint is functioning correctly and returning expected data.
</DOCSTRING>
